findings.detail: The extracted GAV uses the debt and equity subtotal of 645,193,114 instead of total investments of 1,198,298,004.
Cash equivalents of 9,351,973 and short-term investments of 543,752,917 are present in the schedule but excluded from the observed GAV subtotal.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows the observed fund_quarter_fv_m of 645.193114 million ties exactly to the source row for Total Debt & Equity Investments, not to the filing's full investments-at-fair-value total. The same schedule reports Total Investments at 1,198.298004 million after adding cash equivalents and short-term investments, and the fair-value hierarchy corroborates Level 3 debt/equity of 645.193 million plus Level 1 cash/short-term assets of 553.105 million for a total of 1,198.298 million. Therefore the F20 GAV reconciliation warning is a real under-extraction of the investments-at-fair-value anchor.
